verification.interpretation: The full-square composition is preserved. The Runtime WebP is bilinear downsampled from the same source canvas with compression/edge rounding under one pixel; no crop or UV remap is required.

diameterRule: OrbLocal D is the live coreSize supplied by RecognitionPhotoFlowGeometry (68dp compact, 80dp normal; camera handoff interpolates into that size). The core Image is drawn at D/0.84; convert leaf D amplitudes to image UV by multiplying by 0.84.
shaderMasks: The four exact 1254x1254 source-wide masks are sampled at normalized full-square UV; app runtime decodes them at 1/3 sample size without changing normalized UV.
